changelog:
* Fix: fix order lookup in check_payment for integrated payment
* Fix: secure the OAuth setup callback and the PayPlug REST routes (capability check, nonce, POST only)
* Change: PayPlug settings now require the WooCommerce manage_woocommerce capability (editors lose access, shop managers gain it, GET on payplug_api routes is removed)
* Fix: Apple Pay and integrated/popup card AJAX endpoints now check that the order belongs to the current customer
* Fix: order-pay Apple Pay and card payment creation refuse orders that no longer need payment
* Fix: Apple Pay payment update charges the order total instead of the amount sent by the browser, and cancelling the Apple Pay sheet only deletes orders created by the Apple Pay cart button
* Fix: Apple Pay cart and product buttons limit the orders a visitor can create (10 attempts per 10 minutes per customer or session, 100 per IP address read from REMOTE_ADDR only), adjustable or disabled with the payplug_applepay_dummy_order_rate_limit filter; shops behind a reverse proxy that hides the visitor IP should raise or disable the IP limit with this filter
* Fix: Apple Pay contact data sent to update_applepay_order is sanitised (no more backslashes before apostrophes, invalid fields ignored)
* Fix: Apple Pay cart and product buttons show an error instead of staying blocked when WooCommerce cannot create the order, and the Apple Pay product page add-to-cart request rejects invalid product ids and quantities
* Change: update_applepay_order answers {"success":true} instead of returning the order
* Change: removed the unused public methods applepay_empty_cart() and applepay_add_to_cart() from PayplugWoocommerceRequest (Apple Pay keeps using the handlers of Front\ApplePay)
